source_hash_semantics: executed_bytes_sha256 hashes the frozen Windows working bytes used by Docker. git_normalized_sha256 applies the published .gitattributes text rules, preserving explicit -text/binary files. Snapshots/logs remain private; these hashes do not claim prior attempts equal the final source.
validation_scope: frontend only; no claim of rerunning backend checks
